arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

Please find below the Q1 market data information for Acme as requested. Let me know if you have any questions.

Summary of key Q1 market data for Acme (from client briefing records):

- Category share (protein bars):
  • 2026-01-06: 18.4% (US total, share up 60bps QoQ)
  • 2026-02-03: 18.6% (US total, share holding steady)
  • 2026-03-08: 18.9% (US total, share continuing to grow)
- Retail velocity (protein bar SKU):
  • 2026-01-12: 4.7 units/store/week (US total, steady, top-3 SKU in category)
  • 2026-02-08: 4.9 units/store/week (US total, Q1 promo driving trial)
  • 2026-03-18: 5.1 units/store/week (US total, best Q1 reading, momentum continues)
- Regional momentum:
  • 2026-01-15: +12% YoY (US Southeast, strongest region)
  • 2026-02-16: +8% YoY (US West, below plan +12%)
  • 2026-03-25: +9% YoY (US Northeast, steady)
- Promo lift:
  • 2026-01-23: +22% during MLK weekend reset (US total, outperformed planned +15%)
  • 2026-02-27: +18% during Super Bowl window (US total, met plan)
- Share of voice (digital):
  • 2026-02-22: 33% of category SOV (US total, leading in category)
  • 2026-03-30: 34% of category SOV (US total, steady leadership)

If you need the full data table or have specific questions, please let me know!

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group

Task message for executor:

1. Locate the "Acme Q1 market data information" in the client's briefing records. Search your principal's email or file storage if necessary.
2. Identify Priya at Acme. Use the email_client.search_contacts_by_name tool with the term "Priya Acme" or similar variations to find the correct contact and gather her email address.
3. Compose a new email to Priya at Acme, with the subject "Acme Q1 Market Data Information" (or a similar clear subject).
4. Attach or include the Q1 market data information from the client briefing records.
5. In the body of the email, include a brief note along the lines of: "Dear Priya, Please find attached/included the Q1 market data information for Acme as requested. Let me know if you have any questions."
6. Send the email.
7. Confirm completion to your principal.
